function.name: read_planning_topics
function.description: Read site-level assumptions, open questions and answers independently of Blueprint and App Plan. Responses include updatedAt; pass it as expectedUpdatedAt when updating an existing topic. Lists return bounded summaries; supply ids for full details including suggestions, options and confirmation evidence. Read these before planning or implementation; recorded confirmation is not permission to implement.

ids.description: Stable topic IDs for full details; empty returns summaries.

status.description: Optional filter: open, answered, confirmed or dismissed.

artifact.description: Optional filter: site, blueprint or app-plan. Includes site-wide topics.

cursor.description: Nonnegative integer pagination cursor. Omit or use 0 on the first request; use the returned nextCursor for subsequent pages and keep the same filters. Stop when nextCursor is null.

maxItems.description: Maximum items per page: integer from 1 to 30, default 20. Use 20 on the first request; follow nextCursor for remaining items.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
